name: Question 5
problem:
The matrix $A$ and the vector $b$ are given below. Determine if $b\in \text{Col}(A).$ In the affirmative case, find the value of ${x}_{1}\cdot {x}_{2}$, where ${x}_{1}$ and ${x}_{2}$ are real numbers such that $b={x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2},$ and ${a}_{1},$ ${a}_{2}$ are the respective columns of $A.$

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 \\ \,\,-2 & \,\,-2 \\ \,\,-1 & \,\,-1\end{aligned}],\,b=[\begin{aligned}\,\,-4 \\ 2 \\ 2\end{aligned}]
$$
worked_solution:
In order to determine whether $b$ lies in $\text{Col}(A),$ we need to check if the equation $Ax=b$ is consistent. So, let's find the row echelon form of the augmented matrix $[A\,|\,b]$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}[A\,|\,b] & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & \,\,-4 \\ \,\,-2 & \,\,-2 & 2 \\ \,\,-1 & \,\,-1 & 2\end{aligned}] &  & \begin{aligned}{R}_{2}:={R}_{2}+2{R}_{1} \\ {R}_{3}:={R}_{3}+{R}_{1}\end{aligned} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & \,\,-4 \\ 0 & \,\,2 & -6 \\ 0 & 1 & -2\end{aligned}] &  & {R}_{3}:={R}_{3}-\frac{1}{2}{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & \,\,-4 \\ 0 & \,\,2 & -6 \\ 0 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we have the system

$$
{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}+2{x}_{2}=-4 \\ 2{x}_{2}=-6 \\ 0=1.\end{aligned}
$$

From the third equation, we get the false statement $0=1.$ 

Therefore, the system is inconsistent, which implies that $b\notin \text{Col}(A).$
